status: Read-only PostgreSQL plan-review patterns. Hypotheses only; not runtime rules or automatic tuning.
required_plan_format: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON), sanitized and supplied by the user

patterns.symptom: Actual rows materially diverge from estimated rows on a consequential node.
patterns.observation: Record direction, magnitude, loops, and downstream join or scan choice.
patterns.stop_rule: Do not prescribe a join, index, or statistics change until the mismatch is repeatable and its cause is evidenced.

patterns.symptom: A small inner node is executed many times.
patterns.observation: Calculate repeated work and identify the outer node producing the loops.
patterns.stop_rule: Do not condemn a nested loop from node type alone.

patterns.symptom: A large scan appears on the dominant branch.
patterns.observation: Describe the fraction read and returned plus physical/logical I/O.
patterns.stop_rule: A sequential scan is not evidence of a missing index.

patterns.symptom: Hash batches or temporary I/O indicate a hash operation exceeded its in-memory shape.
patterns.observation: Record build-side rows, batches, memory, and temp read/write evidence.
patterns.stop_rule: Do not raise memory settings without workload-wide concurrency evidence.

patterns.symptom: A sort uses disk or produces substantial temporary I/O.
patterns.observation: Record rows, width, ordering requirement, disk use, and temp I/O.
patterns.stop_rule: Do not remove a required sort or change memory from disk use alone.

patterns.symptom: Parallel execution launches fewer workers than planned or shows uneven work.
patterns.observation: Record launch shortfall, skew, leader contribution, and gather overhead.
patterns.stop_rule: Do not change server-wide parallel settings from one plan.

patterns.symptom: Many rows are removed by a filter after expensive input work.
patterns.observation: Locate where rows are discarded and quantify the upstream work feeding them.
patterns.stop_rule: Never push a predicate if doing so changes null, join, or aggregation semantics.

patterns.symptom: A change is claimed to improve the query.
patterns.observation: Compare equivalent node work, buffers, spills, execution time, and output.
patterns.stop_rule: Without equivalent results and comparable conditions, return needs-evidence.
